response.opening: Hi Padma, following up on your kids yoga summer camp idea you said yes to, here’s a practical first outline for Zen Yoga Studio.
response.detail: Suggested format: a 4-week camp with 3 classes each week for ages 7–12, priced at ₹2,499; parents can book by replying to your WhatsApp. Your 95 active members and positive mentions of small classes support a focused, boutique format.
response.ask: Reply YES to approve this outline for the next draft.
response.rationale: Uses the agreed kids programme idea, suggested format and price, plus 95 members and small-class feedback; asks for approval.
